That may or may not have been Ana (face turned away, hood and so on), so by the rules this stays inconclusive and is not counted as time billed but not seen. The cameras last recognised Ana at 11:00, and an unrecognised person passed the door at 12:58, so the end of the visit cannot be confirmed from the cameras. Camera times show passages through the entry, not the work done between them. A good next step is to ask Ana when she left that day.
